fusions.name: Dead Centre
fusions.desc: Throws a dart at a spot you have picked out, up to 8 tiles away. It deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit. The damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Picking the Spot
fusions.desc: A hard stare across a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinned by a Stare
fusions.desc: Your stare holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds. When it lets go, they move 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
